name: @pipeworx/mcp-shopify

tools.name: shopify_list_products
tools.description: List products from a Shopify store. Returns up to 50 products by default.

limit.description: Number of products to return (max 250, default 50)

tools.name: shopify_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single Shopify product by numeric ID, returning its title, description, variants, pricing, inventory, and images via the Admin API.

tools.name: shopify_list_orders
tools.description: List orders from a Shopify store, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Filter by status: open, closed, cancelled, any (default: open)

limit.description: Number of orders to return (max 250, default 50)

tools.name: shopify_get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single Shopify order by numeric ID, returning line items, customer info, fulfillment status, totals, and shipping address via the Admin API.

tools.name: shopify_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in a Shopify store (up to 250 per call). Returns customer IDs, names, emails, order counts, and total spend. Requires Admin API access token and shop domain.

limit.description: Number of customers to return (max 250, default 50)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-shopify forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the shopify pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
